$comment: The needles the standards gate forbids, held as data so no scanned source file spells one.
The gate reads a file with the needles of the language its extension names, and it reads
no .json file, so this file is invisible to the scan and the gate's own Go source is clean.
escapes: a type-checker escape hatch. Forbidden outright: fix the type instead.
suppressions: a lint suppression. Group 1 holds the comma-separated rules it silences, and
an empty group silences every rule. Each count must match .loop/suppressions.json exactly.
focus: a focused test, which runs one case and still reports green.
